metrics.workdir_dsl:
workspace "Bank Portal" "A C4 model of the online banking platform" {
    model {
        customer = person "Bank Customer" "Manages accounts, moves money, and tracks activity"

        bankPortal = softwareSystem "Bank Portal" "The online banking platform, owned and operated by our company" {
            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where customers log in and manage their accounts" "Web App"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the bank's mobile app" "API"
            accountService = container "Account Service" "Holds the customer account records" "Service"
            transactionService = container "Transaction Service" "Processes deposits, withdrawals, and transfers" "Service"
            paymentService = container "Payment Service" "Executes card payments and bank transfers" "Service"
            cardService = container "Card Service" "Manages debit and credit cards" "Service"
            fraudDetectionService = container "Fraud Detection Service" "Scores transactions for fraud" "Service"
            notificationService = container "Notification Service" "Sends email and SMS alerts" "Service"
            onboardingService = container "Onboarding Service" "Verifies new customers" "Service"
            statementsService = container "Statements Service" "Generates monthly statements" "Service"
            directDebitService = container "Direct Debit Service" "Processes standing orders and direct debits" "Service"
            exchangeRatesService = container "Exchange Rates Service" "Provides currency conversion rates" "Service"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly interest calculation and reconciliation" "Batch"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries internal events between the application parts" "Queue"
            ledgerDatabase = container "Ledger Database" "Stores every account movement" "Database"
            customerDatabase = container "Customer Database" "Stores account and profile records" "Database"
            auditDatabase = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail" "Database"
            cache = container "Cache" "Stores sessions and frequently read account data" "Cache"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds the generated statement PDFs" "Document Store"
        }

        cardPaymentNetwork = softwareSystem "Card Payment Network" "Routes card authorisations, operated by a different organization" <External>
        creditReferenceAgency = softwareSystem "Credit Reference Agency" "Performs credit checks, operated by a different organization" <External>

        customer -> webPortal "manages accounts, moves money, and tracks activity"
        customer -> mobileAppBackend "via the bank's mobile app"

        paymentService -> cardPaymentNetwork "routes card authorisations"
        onboardingService -> creditReferenceAgency "performs credit checks"

        webPortal -> accountService "uses"
        webPortal -> transactionService "uses"
        webPortal -> paymentService "uses"
        webPortal -> cardService "uses"
        webPortal -> statementsService "uses"
        webPortal -> directDebitService "uses"

        mobileAppBackend -> accountService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> transactionService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> paymentService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> cardService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> statementsService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> directDebitService "uses"

        transactionService -> ledgerDatabase "updates"
        transactionService -> fraudDetectionService "scores transactions"
        transactionService -> eventQueue "publishes events"

        notificationService -> eventQueue "consumes events"

        statementsService -> ledgerDatabase "reads"
        statementsService -> documentStore "writes"

        batchScheduler -> ledgerDatabase "reads and writes"
        batchScheduler -> customerDatabase "reads and writes"

        paymentService -> cardService "uses"
        paymentService -> exchangeRatesService "uses"

        onboardingService -> customerDatabase "reads"
    }

    views {
        systemContext bankPortal "SystemContext" "How customers and external systems interact with the Bank Portal" {
            include *
            autoLayout
        }

        container bankPortal "CustomerFacing" "How customers use the platform" {
            include customer webPortal mobileAppBackend accountService transactionService paymentService cardService statementsService directDebitService
            autoLayout
        }

        container bankPortal "RiskCompliance" "How transactions are processed and secured" {
            include transactionService fraudDetectionService eventQueue notificationService paymentService cardPaymentNetwork onboardingService creditReferenceAgency customerDatabase ledgerDatabase
            autoLayout
        }

        container bankPortal "DataAndBatch" "How data is stored and batch processing runs" {
            include batchScheduler statementsService ledgerDatabase customerDatabase auditDatabase cache documentStore eventQueue
            autoLayout
        }
    }
}
